front.label: Front
front.desc: The Hyperliquid mark, your name, and your edition number.

front.label: Name
front.desc: Your .hl or .eth name. It stays off the card until you are eligible, then the laser writes it live, line by line, in passes that run left and right.

front.label: Hyperliquid shape
front.desc: The Hyperliquid mark built only from dots, each one a single laser pulse. Dot size follows a slow wave, so the shape catches light like brushed metal.

front.label: Number
front.desc: Your card out of 25, in dot matrix. The laser etches it right after your name.

back.label: Back
back.desc: Hyperliquid in words and numbers, with the logo x logo at the centre.

back.label: Logo x logo
back.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS at the centre of the back, the only marks on it.

back.label: Words
back.desc: Hyperliquid and ENS in words, sixty to forty: HyperCore, HyperBFT, order book, HLP and the assets traded on it, beside namehash, resolver, subnames, primary name and .eth.

back.label: The numbers
back.desc: Set quieter among the words: TGE 29.11.2024, 1,000,000,000 max supply, 310,000,000 airdrop to 94,023 genesis wallets, the allocation split, 200,000 orders per second at 0.2 s median latency.
